svg.title: Monopolistic competition in the short run and the long run
svg.desc: Left: in the short run a monopolistically competitive firm produces Q1 where MR = MC and charges P1 from its demand curve; P1 is above ATC, so it earns the shaded economic profit. Right: entry shifts each firm's demand left until, in the long run, demand is tangent to ATC at Q2, where P = ATC and economic profit is zero. Q2 is less than the quantity at minimum ATC: excess capacity. Price is above MC.
svg.text: D is tangent to ATC at Q2:
